items.title: 1.3 Domain Eukarya ke kingdoms ki khaas khasoosiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.3, from printed pages 7-10.

blocks.text: Domain Eukarya chaar kingdoms par mushtamil hai: Protista, Fungi, Plantae aur Animalia. Is mein tamam eukaryotes shamil hain, yani woh jandar jin ke cells complex eukaryotic cells hain, jin mein nucleus aur doosre membrane wale organelles hote hain. Is topic mein hum dekhenge ke har kingdom doosron se kaise alag hai.

Kingdom Protista mein woh eukaryotes aate hain jo unicellular (ek cell wale), colonial (cells ki basti), filamentous (dhaage jaise) ya saada multicellular hote hain. Saada multicellular ka matlab hai ke un mein multicellular sex organs nahi hote. Protists teen qisam ke hote hain.

items: Protozoa janwaron jaise (animal-like) protists hain. Yeh unicellular aur heterotrophic hote hain, yani apni ghiza khud nahi banate. Misaalein: Paramecium, Amoeba, Plasmodium aur Trypanosoma.

Algae podon jaise (plant-like) protists hain. In ki cell walls cellulose ki hoti hain, in mein chlorophyll hota hai aur yeh autotrophs hain, yani photosynthesis se apni ghiza khud banate hain. Misaalein: Euglena aur diatoms.

Myxomycota aur Oomycota fungi jaise protists hain. In mein hyphae jaisi banawat hoti hai aur yeh saprophytic hote hain, yani mari hui cheezon se ghiza lete hain. Misaalein: slime moulds aur water moulds.

blocks.title: Bimari paida karne wale protists
blocks.text: Kuch protists parasites hain. Plasmodium malaria paida karta hai, Entamoeba histolytica amoebic dysentery (pechish) paida karta hai, aur Trypanosoma sleeping sickness paida karta hai.

Fungi eukaryotic aur heterotrophic jandar hain jo unicellular ya multicellular ho sakte hain. In ke cells par chitin ki bani cell wall hoti hai; chitin ek polysaccharide hai. Fungi ghiza hasil karne ka anokha tareeqa rakhte hain: yeh janwaron aur kuch protists ki tarah ghiza nigalte (ingest) nahi, balke apne ird gird se ghiza jazb (absorb) karte hain. Misaalein: mushrooms, rusts, smuts aur moulds (phaphoondi).

items: Zygomycota woh fungi hain jin ke hyphae mein septa (cross walls, yani andar ki deewarein) nahi hote. Misal: Rhizopus, yani bread mould, jo geeli roti aur phalon par ugta hai.
Ascomycota fungi ka sab se bara group hai. In ke hyphae septate hote hain, yani un mein septa hote hain. Misaalein: aam moulds, morels, truffles, cup fungi, Neurospora aur yeasts (khameer).
Basidiomycota ke hyphae bhi septate hote hain. Misaalein: mushrooms, toadstools, puffballs, jelly fungi, bracket ya shelf fungi, rusts aur smuts.

blocks.title: Rozmarra zindagi mein fungi
blocks.text: Kuch fungi roti (bread), paneer (cheese) aur beer banane mein istemaal hote hain. Kuch mein dawa ki khasoosiyat hain: penicillin, ek antibiotic, fungus Penicillium se hasil hoti hai. Fungi ki taqreeban 100,000 maloom species hain. Zyada tar ascomycetes lichens mein paye jate hain, aur kuch mycorrhizae mein (podon ki jaron ke saath saajhedaari).

Kingdom Plantae mein poday (plants) aate hain: eukaryotic, multicellular jandar jin ki cell walls cellulose ki bani hoti hain. Yeh autotrophic hain aur photosynthesis se apni ghiza banate hain. Tamam poday embryo se develop hote hain. Misaalein: mosses (kaai), ferns, conifers aur phool wale poday (flowering plants).

items: Non-vascular plants, yani bryophytes, mein paani aur ghiza le jaane wale tissues (xylem aur phloem) nahi hote. Misaalein: liverworts, hornworts aur mosses.

Vascular plants mein yeh conducting tissues hote hain. Yeh do qisam ke hain: seedless plants (beej ke baghair), jaise ferns, aur seed plants (beej wale), jaise conifers (pine, Cedrus, Ginkgo) aur flowering plants (shimla mirch yani capsicum, sarson yani mustard).

blocks.alt: Ek shaakh-daar chart. Kingdom Plantae non-vascular plants (bryophytes: moss, liverwort, hornwort) aur vascular plants mein batta hai. Vascular plants seedless plants (ferns) aur seed plants (conifers aur flowering plants) mein batte hain.
blocks.caption: Kingdom Plantae ke bare groups (Figure 1.8 ke mutabiq asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Podon ko pehle is buniyad par baanta jata hai ke un mein conducting tissue hai ya nahi. Phir vascular plants ko is buniyad par baanta jata hai ke woh beej banate hain ya nahi. Seed plants mein conifers jaise pine aur Cedrus, aur flowering plants jaise capsicum aur mustard shamil hain.

blocks.text: Eukaryotes ki is kingdom mein janwar (animals) aate hain, jo eukaryotic, multicellular aur heterotrophic hain. Yeh embryo se develop hote hain. Yeh ghiza nigalte (ingest) hain aur apne jism ke andar hazam (digest) karte hain. Kingdom Animalia ki phyla mein classification agle topic ka mauzoo hai.
Teen domains ke kingdoms ka muqabla

Textbook kingdoms ko ek table mein samet deti hai. Bacteria aur Archaea dono purane kingdom naam Monera ke neeche dikhaye gaye hain, kyunke paanch-kingdom system har prokaryote ko wahin rakhta tha. Har column ko ek kingdom ka tarruf (profile) samajh kar parhein.

blocks.caption: Teen domains ke kingdoms ki pehchaan wali khasoosiyat
rows: Cell wall kis se bani hai

items: Protista: unicellular, colonial, filamentous ya saada multicellular eukaryotes; janwaron jaise protozoa, podon jaise algae, aur fungi jaise slime aur water moulds.
Fungi: chitin ki walls; ghiza nigalne ke bajaye jazb karte hain; Zygomycota (septa nahi), Ascomycota aur Basidiomycota (septate hyphae).
Plantae: cellulose ki walls, photosynthetic, embryo se develop; non-vascular bryophytes aur vascular plants (seedless aur seed plants).
Animalia: multicellular, heterotrophic, embryo se develop, ghiza nigal kar andar hazam karte hain.
Sirf janwaron mein cell wall nahi hoti; sirf fungi mein chitin ki wall hai; sirf podon mein cellulose ki wall ke saath har rukun photosynthetic autotroph hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek multicellular eukaryote apne ird gird se ghiza jazb karta hai aur us ki cell walls chitin ki hain. Yeh kis kingdom mein hai, aur sirf cell wall ki buniyad par kaun si doosri kingdom khaarij ho jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh fungus hai. Chitin ki wall Plantae ko khaarij karti hai, jin ki walls cellulose ki hoti hain, aur Animalia ko bhi, jin mein cell wall hoti hi nahi.
